description.value: A within-subject fMRI study investigated changes in neural responses to high- and low-energy food and non-food odors and pictures before and two months after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass surgery, alongside food preferences and appetite-related biochemical measures.
Within-subject longitudinal pre- and post-RYGB design.
